method: Exact published lb tables; linear interpolation between bodyweight rows, nearest row outside range. No age adjustment. 5/20/50/80/95 percentile anchors; intermediate percentiles and 5RM/8RM are estimates. Community lift counts are entries, not unique participants or qualifying sample sizes.

sources.note: Community reference, not a controlled research norm. Machine leverage, pulley ratio, setup and range of motion affect the load; compare progress on the same machine with consistent technique. Do not treat the percentile as an exact rank across machines. Use the seated two-leg variation; lying and single-leg curls are different exercises.
